headline: Russia and Ukraine ready for "practical compromises" to end war — Kushner
summary: US special envoy Jared Kushner said Russia and Ukraine are prepared to make practical compromises to end the war. No specific terms were given in the statement.
why: Progress toward ending the Russia-Ukraine war would affect European energy, grain and commodity supply expectations, as well as sanctions policy.
original_headline: РФ и Украина готовы к «практическим компромиссам» для завершения войны — Кушнер
